cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

Clarification of the concepts of rehabilitation, recultivation, revitalization, remediation, decontamination. Distribution of decontamination technologies. The most frequently used decontamination technologies in the Czech Republic. Overview of old burdens in the Czech Republic. (allowance 3/2)
Movement of contaminants in the environment. Pollution sampling and monitoring. (allowance 3/2)
Survey design, risk analysis and feasibility studies. Funding sources. (allowance 3/2)
Physico-chemical foundations of decontamination technologies. (allowance 3/2)
Sanitation methods of saturated and unsaturated zones. (allowance 3/2)
Land reclamation after mining activities. Reclamation of land after surface mining of raw materials. (allowance 3/2)
Land consolidation in areas affected by mining. (allowance 3/2)
Use of the principles of successive restoration of small areas. Hydraulic reclamation. (allowance 3/2)
Reclamation of heavy soils. (allowance 3/2)
Reclamation of light soils. (allowance 3/2)
Reclamation of solidified, acidic and saline soils. (allowance 3/2)
Soil-biological aspects of different methods of bioremediation, limiting factors. (allowance 3/2)
Phytodegradation, rhizodegradation, phytostabilization, phytoaccumulation, rhizofiltration, phytovolatilization. (allowance 3/2)
Cometabolic bioremediation. Use of pyrolyzed materials for bioremediation. (allowance 3/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Clarify the issues students care about soil fertility in terms of ecological function in the landscape and sustainable agriculture. To teach them the ways of soil reclamation and rehabilitation of damaged natural and anthropogenic, and to restore their ecological and production functions.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Clarification of the concepts of rehabilitation, recultivation, revitalization, remediation, decontamination. Distribution of decontamination technologies. The most frequently used decontamination technologies in the Czech Republic. Overview of old burdens in the Czech Republic. (allowance 3/2)2.Movement of contaminants in the environment. Pollution sampling and monitoring. (allowance 3/2)3.Survey design, risk analysis and feasibility studies. Funding sources. (allowance 3/2)4.Physico-chemical foundations of decontamination technologies. (allowance 3/2)5.Sanitation methods of saturated and unsaturated zones. (allowance 3/2)6.Land reclamation after mining activities. Reclamation of land after surface mining of raw materials. (allowance 3/2)7.Land consolidation in areas affected by mining. (allowance 3/2)8.Use of the principles of successive restoration of small areas. Hydraulic reclamation. (allowance 3/2)9.Reclamation of heavy soils. (allowance 3/2)10.Reclamation of light soils. (allowance 3/2)11.Reclamation of solidified, acidic and saline soils. (allowance 3/2)12.Soil-biological aspects of different methods of bioremediation, limiting factors. (allowance 3/2)13.Phytodegradation, rhizodegradation, phytostabilization, phytoaccumulation, rhizofiltration, phytovolatilization. (allowance 3/2)14.Cometabolic bioremediation. Use of pyrolyzed materials for bioremediation. (allowance 3/2)
